operator_direction: Start microSD initialization after the first branded frame, dial 555-1212 with DTMF-style tones at 10/10 during loading, recover the confirmed corrupt card through H2, and install every enabled game under SD GAMES for dynamic discovery without embedding games in firmware.

ota_data.live_policy: mutable boot-selection state; preserve without writing

predecessor.manual_result: 0.4.2 booted the official loading UI with 10/10 audio and H2 identity; the interrupted corrupt-card format exposed both the 8 KiB host write split requirement and the format-required ownership recovery bug addressed by this successor

sd_bundle.formatting: one-time host recovery of verified corrupt exFAT

runtime_contract: submit the official 768x480 landscape logo before storage or audio work
start the microSD worker immediately after the first branded frame
dial 555-1212 with 697/770 Hz low and 1209/1336 Hz high DTMF pairs at 10/10
report measured dial and storage initialization milliseconds
keep the loading screen until storage reaches ready or degraded
present Program Manager only after the SD directory catalog is loaded
load executable games only from microSD GAMES/*.P4G with root compatibility
export format-required media to macOS through native H2 device MSC
split each host write into 4 KiB DMA-safe SD transactions and read back each chunk
never initiate a card format from firmware

execution_contract.sd_write_route: exclusive H2 USB-device MSC after successor boot; one-time macOS MBR/exFAT P4GAMES recovery then verified /GAMES package copy

acceptance_required_after_install: official logo is the first useful frame
555-1212 is visibly dialed and audibly plays seven dual-frequency tones at 10/10
STORAGE_INIT_BEGIN precedes BOOT_DIAL and logs measured elapsed milliseconds
format-required media enumerates on H2 instead of becoming app-owned fault state
macOS formats only the confirmed 32 GB P4 Game Storage disk as MBR/exFAT P4GAMES
the SD installer copies and verifies all 12 P4G packages under /GAMES
clean host eject remounts the card and the launcher dynamically discovers all 12 packages
the OTA application contains no enabled P4G package payload
no panic, watchdog, display timeout, concurrent filesystem ownership, or failed verified host write occurs
